# P15 progress — profile comparison complete

Completed the first unfinished reviewed group on 4 October 2026. Retained-findings, history-and-uncertainty, accounting-and-sectors, language-research-integration and profile-comparison are saved. Do not repeat these groups. Full P15 remains partial; **integrate-review** is next.

The audit now compares corporate/shared-IR, typed-library-first, instrument-first and broad sector-first on ten common obligation groups spanning MC01–MC35/G1–G18. Authoring and domain scope are separate: typed-library-first holds the corporate domain fixed; instrument-first cannot claim whole-company completion; broad sector-first requires the missing admitted sector/authority methods. Each option has consequences, disqualifying omissions, dependencies and selection examples. None is selected or ranked by code availability, effort, performance or usability.

Coverage updates profile fields and E06, adds E10–E14 (representation/authoring, numerical capability, entity/aggregation memory, scenarios/weights and software semantic boundaries), and records the saved comparison in MC23/MC34. Every decision has proposed answer, alternative, consequence and next step. All 18 gap rows and 15 historical-phase rows remain identical to entry; all other requirement rows retain their substantive content. The audit/reference hashes and current completion wording were refreshed.

Skeptical audit used current sources as baseline and kept prototype defaults hypothetical. Matched interface tasks keep domain/inputs/results fixed; changed domain coverage must be explicit. Common-compiler agreement, source counts, balanced journals and structural passes cannot select architecture. Candidate-specific dependency order must account for history construction's dependence on event/state semantics. No scientific run, new default, product implementation, new test or external service was used.
